messages:
incident-bot: Paging: p99 latency > 2.5s on /v1/generate (continuous-batching path) in us-west-2. SLO alert triggered (p99 10m window). Auto-triage suggests: increased queueing, mixed sequence-length skew.
Maya: got it. I'm oncall. Anyone already looking at traces?
Arjun: I started a flamegraph and live trace -- looks like batch scheduling stalls at commit time when large-seq requests push KV flushes. p95 mostly fine, p99 dominated by a small subset of long-seq beams.
Liam: confirming, see a cluster of streams that hit streaming stalls while waiting for a full batch. Fairshare scheduler didn't preempt small requests.
Maya: what's current mitigation we can do live? Can we shed or split long sequences?
Arjun: immediate mitigations: 1) reduce max_batch_size for cont-batch path from 64 -> 32 2) enable preemptive-shedding for streaming with threshold 0.75 3) group by seqlen heuristic (short-first).
Priya: push priority: reduce customer impact first. Which of those is lowest-risk?
Liam: reducing max_batch_size is low-risk config flip (no code change). preemptive-shedding needs tiny runtime toggle but has more churn. Group-by-seqlen requires routing tweak, higher risk.
Maya: ok please flip max_batch_size -> 32 on the node-pool handling cont-batch (usw2-contbatch-pool). Arjun, can you prepare the toggle for preemptive-shedding as follow-up?
Arjun: on it. Running command now:
```
# set config on pool
rdwctl pool update --name usw2-contbatch-pool --set contbatch.max_batch_size=32
rdwctl pool update --name usw2-contbatch-pool --set scheduler.preempt_enabled=true
```
Arjun: applied to 5/6 hosts, one host hit transient API error, retrying.
deploy-bot: config-update: rdwctl(pool=usw2-contbatch-pool) - 5 hosts updated, 1 failed (retry queued).
Maya: watching p99 in grafana (alerts dashboard). Also enable tracing sampling for affected model to 100% for 10m.
Liam: realtime: p99 fell from 2.7s -> 1.6s within 90s of batch_size flip. But we still have tail spikes at ~3s from large-seq beams.
Eve: CS: which customers are impacted? Any enterprise requests failing?
Maya: early look, small percentage of calls slowed but not errors. CS, please prepare message: explain short latency blip, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m for full normalization.
Eve: acknowledged, prepping customer note.
Arjun: follow-up plan: push a scheduler patch to prefer short-seq-first (opt-in) and add a batch size dynamic that decays with observed queueing. I'll open a PR and we can canary in a few hours.
Maya: for now, leave preempt_enabled true and monitor. I'll escalate to severity 2 if p99 > 2s again.
Priya: any risk of regression to correctness? Does reducing batch_size affect model outputs?
Arjun: negligible; batching only affects throughput, not model weights or decoding. Decoding stochasticity unchanged.
Liam: adding a short-term tracing note: see traces/2145001234/trace-id-9f3a for a representative stall. Key ops: schedule_wait -> commit_wait -> kv-evict -> decode_start. 
Maya: handoff note: I'll be oncall for next 20m then handing to Sofia for night watch. Sofia, if p99 doesn't stabilize under 2s within 30m, escalate to infra-eng and notify customers.
Sofia: acknowledged. I'll take the handoff at 21:40 UTC.
Arjun: opened issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 "contbatch: seqlen imbalance causes tail latency" details + quick mitigation steps. PR draft: https://git.redwood/inf/runtime/pull/987 (contains scheduler fairness + metrics).
Maya: update from deploy-bot: retry succeeded, all 6 hosts updated.
deploy-bot: config-update: rdwctl(pool=usw2-contbatch-pool) - 6 hosts updated.
Liam: monitoring: p99 now 1.4s, p95 0.35s. No obvious error rate increase. Streaming stalls reduced.
Eve: sent customer note to pilot customers: "We observed a temporary latency increase; engineers applied a mitigation that reduced impact. We're rolling a permanent fix." replies pending.
Priya: ProdOps - capture post-incident: timeline, mitigation steps, config diffs (merged), and signal to include in incident review.
Maya: quick checklist before handing off:
- confirm traces collected (done)
- confirm all hosts updated (done)
- CS note sent (done)
- PR opened for long-term fix (done)
- keep preempt_enabled until PR can be rolled (agreed)
Maya: handing off to Sofia now. If anything flares, ping @Maya + #eng-oncall.
Sofia: taking handoff. Running quick sanity query:
```
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",le="+Inf"}[1m])) by (le)
```
Sofia: will watch p99 and traces. Good job team, thanks.
Liam: one postmortem note: consider adding a seqlen-aware admission controller that buckets requests into small/medium/large and enforces separate batch pools -> could remove this class of tail spike. Filing as follow-up.
Maya: adding to postmortem: suggested mitigations & timeline. Closing the live mitigation loop.
incident-bot: Incident auto-closure check: no active alerts on cont-batch after 15m; mark as mitigated if stable for next 30m."
